description: See how The Standard Reserve (TSR) S-Bill rate has moved over time, on Robinhood Chain: every on-chain rate change (deposits, admin changes, pause) plus periodic drift samples, each tagged by source and carrying the term length in force at that point, oldest first. term_changes lists every admin term-length change in the window separately. Rates are per term, not annual. Fields ending in _wad are 18-decimal fractions as strings.

hours.description: Trailing window in hours. Default 168 (7 days), max 2160 (90 days).

name: 1s_std_sbills_rate_history
title: TSR S-Bill Rate History
